statement: Wistron opened a 324,000-square-foot greenfield plant in Fort Worth, Texas, to manufacture NVIDIA AI systems.
why: New U.S. manufacturing capacity expands the supply of NVIDIA AI systems.

impact.mechanism: A new plant adds AI-system build-and-test capacity, easing supply of finished systems.

evidence.excerpt: Wistron opened its first U.S. manufacturing facility, a 324,000-square-foot greenfield plant in Fort Worth, Texas

confidence.basis: Primary source but no capacity, ramp or timeline figures disclosed.
